subject.title: feat: heading-aware chunking + entity extraction for memory search

question: Should memory-core adopt heading/section-aware chunking now, and if so should it be the default behavior or an explicit chunking strategy/config?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the choice affects existing index identity, default recall behavior, and whether entity extraction should be split from this issue.

options.title: Approve narrow chunking first
options.body: Implement heading/section-aware chunking in memory-core with maintainer-chosen default or opt-in semantics and a tested reindex identity path, while splitting entity extraction into separate roadmap work.

options.title: Fold into Memory MVP
options.body: Keep this issue as product backlog and treat both chunking and entity extraction as part of the broader Memory MVP/write-pipeline and wiki design work.

options.title: Decline core chunking change
options.body: Keep token/overlap chunking as the only built-in strategy and ask for retrieval experiments to live outside core until a plugin/API gap is proven.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow chunking first
recommendation.body: Implement heading/section-aware chunking in memory-core with maintainer-chosen default or opt-in semantics and a tested reindex identity path, while splitting entity extraction into separate roadmap work.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced and refactored the memory search/chunking path and is the strongest history-backed owner for the default/config direction.
